coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Bay South Block 22 (park)
record.summary: A landscaped lawn with trees on Mission Bay South's plan Block 22; not a formally named park in any source checked. This project's own satellite review found no building footprint on the site, and a September 2026 owner on-site visit confirmed it is already a completed small park rather than still-planned open space, correcting an earlier satellite-only assessment. No independently published source (a city agency, news outlet or landscape-architecture record) naming or dating it was found.

notes.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced. No internal A/B split needed (this label is a single block).
notes.digitized_from: Real block boundary from real street geometry (src/block_fit.py load_blocks(), trimmed against src/street_geometry.py's fuller street buffer).

changes.text: Mission Bay South Block 22 (park): status corrected from 'planned' to 'complete'. This block had been traced from real street geometry and registered as a future park based on satellite imagery (a landscaped lawn with trees, no dirt, no structure) -- evidence consistent with either a finished small park or an interim-landscaped future site. The owner has been on site and confirmed it is complete. That ambiguity should have been flagged as a question rather than resolved by assumption; noted for future passes. A follow-up DataSF Assessor/Building-Footprints check found no structure on the site and traced the dominant underlying parcel to a retired 1998 'COMMON_AREAS' placeholder plus edge fragments of the scattered UCSF campus parcel already flagged for block 17AB -- consistent with open land, but it was the owner's on-site visit, not this lookup, that settled 'complete' vs 'planned'.

open_questions: No independently published source (SF Recreation & Park Department, OCII, news coverage) names or dates this park; the only evidence found is this repo's own satellite-imagery review and the owner's September 2026 on-site confirmation that it is already built, both recorded in the geometry file's own digitization_method log -- not a substitute for a dated public-record source, so no completion milestone is asserted here.

This project's earlier DataSF Assessor Parcels/Building Footprints check (recorded in the same digitization_method log) traced the dominant underlying parcel to a retired 1998 'COMMON_AREAS' placeholder (blklot 8799TBA3, dropped 2005) plus scattered UCSF campus parcel fragments -- consistent with open, non-built land, but that doesn't establish when the current landscaping was actually built.
Not clear whether this block corresponds to any of OCII's lettered/numbered open-space plan parcels (P1-P27) tracked elsewhere in this project; no such label was found for it in any source checked.

record.notes: Owner confirmed on site (2026-09-19) that this park is complete. No building footprint here (satellite- and building-footprint-confirmed); the OCII plan's own Dec 2019 Land Use Map designates this block's future land use as park (shown in park-green). No specific project name, developer, or completion date was found in this pass -- if the owner has one, it would be a useful addition.
